Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I wanted to share a compact plan for the benchmarking and acceptance evidence we'll provide so your SRE and procurement teams can sign off. High level:

- Scope: production-like throughput/latency tests (50k RT requests/day equivalent traffic pattern), prefix caching enabled, quantized model variant as discussed.
- Targets: p95 latency <= 180ms for 1–4 token responses (chat burst pattern); sustained throughput 1800 RPS with 95% success rate for our dedicated run.
- Deliverables: test plan (attached), raw results CSV, annotated findings, action items, and an MPO (mutual progress outline) PDF for signoff.
- Timeline: run scheduled in your preprod on Nov 3–4; Redwood will deliver results and recommended config by EOD Nov 5.

Attachments: aurora-load-plan.yaml (traffic profile + endpoints), mutual-action-plan_Aurora_20261105.pdf (MPO draft).

Next step: Can you confirm Raj and your SRE will accept the traffic window tomorrow (Nov 3, 09:00–13:00 PT)? If so we'll start the first pass at 09:15.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Run complete (Nov 4 window). Attaching the raw CSV in this thread — redwood-benchmark-results-20261103.csv — and a short findings summary below.

Summary findings:
- Sustained throughput: 1,760 RPS (target 1,800). We observed short bursts to 2,200 RPS during cache-warmup.
- Latency (chat pattern, 1–4 token responses): p50=48ms, p95=172ms, p99=320ms. p95 meets target (<=180ms); p99 elevated during large KV-cache misses.
- Error rate: 0.6% (target <1%). Most errors were transient 503s during a downstream network flake at 10:23 which coincides with burst.
- Recommendations: keep prefix cache TTL at 30s for this workload, enable short-lived request-level retries (1 retry) for 503s, and apply the small network routing change we discussed.

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-results-20261103.csv (token-level latencies + request traces).

Next steps:
- We'll push a brief annotated CSV and an MPO PDF by EOD Nov 5 for Aurora signoff.
- Hannah: can you draft the acceptance note for procurement (one paragraph) and loop legal if needed?
